summary: Reexecuted backend and browser regressions. Registration, login/session, dashboard, logout, lockout, forgot-password API/UI, theme toggle, mobile menu, and 390x844 layout pass. Public credentialed CORS preflight remains broken: proxy returns wildcard origin and no allow-credentials.

critical.issue: Public response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true for the frontend origin, despite FastAPI configuration.

action_items: Fix the public proxy/ingress CORS handling so credentialed preflight echoes the explicit frontend origin and includes Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
Remove the duplicate CORS_ORIGINS entries in backend/.env and align the application configuration around one explicit-origin source of truth.
critical_code_review_comments: The public CORS contract is still inconsistent with backend/server.py; browser credentialed auth requests can fail at ingress even though the application middleware is correct.
backend/.env defines CORS_ORIGINS twice and server.py ignores that variable in favor of FRONTEND_URL, creating configuration drift and making deployment behavior harder to reason about.
seed_data_creation: Created unique TEST_/ui temporary users through registration for regression checks; no seeded users were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest public OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin set to the frontend URL after ingress/proxy changes. Core auth/session/dashboard, forgot-password POST, lockout, responsive registration, theme, mobile menu, and logout are passing.
rca of the issue: FastAPI CORSMiddleware is configured with FRONTEND_URL, but the public preview proxy rewrites OPTIONS responses to wildcard CORS and strips credentials support. The application-level CORS change therefore is not reflected at the public endpoint.
